training_history.timer_scope: Input loading, preprocessing, training, validation, CPU metrics and scheduler; excludes subsequent checkpoint/summary persistence, setup, downloads, external evaluation and export.
training_history.missing_from_saved_log: identity seed42 epochs1-10 and identity seed43 epochs1-3 were completed before the resumed cell output; all 13 are present in the returned history.
training_history.timing_caution: Timestamp residuals are not direct CPU/GPU/I/O profiling. Full end-to-end wall time and attributable cache speedup cannot be recovered from these artifacts alone.

checkpoints.independent_weight_hash_or_inference_ver: UNVERIFIED because actual checkpoint files and image files were not supplied

publication_hygiene.credential_pattern_scan: No GitHub token, OpenAI token, AWS access-key identifier or private-key marker matched the targeted scan; this is not a guarantee against every secret format.
private_runtime_paths: executed notebook outputs and source cell
publication_hygiene.case_level_data: split_manifest.csv, predictions.csv and per-run prediction CSVs include NLM case identifiers, labels and image hashes; they are not aggregate-only release artifacts.
publication_hygiene.recommendation: Preserve originals privately. Publish verified aggregate results, plots and clean source notebook; review case-level artifact redistribution separately and redact private execution paths in any public derivative, with new checksums.

limitations: Actual images and model checkpoints were not supplied, so pixel duplication checks, model inference and checkpoint byte hashes could not be independently rerun.
No verified patient map exists; 138 case groups do not establish 138 independent patients.
The absence of saved errors describes the final notebook only; earlier overwritten executions and complete command logs were not supplied.
Hash consistency protects against accidental changes but does not provide a signed, independently timestamped proof of prior test isolation.
The external dataset is now evaluated; future protocol tuning requires new external evidence for confirmatory claims.
No benchmark of physical batches16/32 was executed; no GPU utilization percentage or proven acceleration should be reported.
